summary: CollPlant Biotechnologies Ltd filed a 6-K (the US-equivalent foreign private issuer current report) announcing that its ordinary shares will trade on Nasdaq under the new ticker OPHI effective at the open on November 13, 2026, replacing CLGN after the close on November 12, 2026. No shareholder action is required; the listing and CUSIP remain unchanged. Subject to shareholder approval at an extraordinary general meeting set for November 24, 2026 and consent of the Israeli Registrar of Companies, the company intends to rename itself OptiPhi Computing Ltd, reflecting a pivot toward LightSolver's all-optical Laser Processing Unit technology while retaining rhCollagen and bio-ink assets. No terms, board recommendation, advisor, or risk-arb angle; watch the EGM vote and name-change registration.
